notes: Live https://docs.composio.dev/toolkits/crew_ai lists 8 tools and 0 triggers (slug CREW_AI, version 00000000_00). Index count is 8. Execution routes are the published CrewAI AMP OpenAPI at https://docs.crewai.com/v1.15.27/enterprise-api.en.yaml: GET /inputs, POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id}, POST /resume, each JSON 200 on https://{crew-name}.crewai.com with Authorization Bearer. Control-plane routes are the product Plus API the official CLI calls on https://app.crewai.com, not local Python SDK methods: GET /crewai_plus/api/v1/crews (JSON array), GET /crewai_plus/api/v1/crews/{uuid}/status (JSON object), GET /crewai_plus/api/v1/crews/{uuid}/logs/deployment (JSON array; the tool is deployment lifecycle logs, not a second log_type route), and POST /crewai_plus/api/v1/crews/{uuid}/deploy (body-less, JSON object, documented at https://docs.crewai.com/en/enterprise/guides/deploy-to-amp). crewName is a required DNS label, not a free-form URL. One bearer is stored because the declarative compiler has a single Authorization header; both documented APIs use Authorization: Bearer.
